evidence.claim: MajorMUD is installed and entered as a module under Worldgroup; Worldgroup server setup/security exists outside the MajorMUD game module.
Worldgroup security keys and the WCCMMUD.INI SYS_*_KEY settings form a host-to-module authorization handoff rather than multiple intrinsic MajorMUD administrator levels.
Official MajorMUD help documents MajorMUD-owned game commands, parties, gangs, communication, saving-on-exit and other in-realm behavior separately from the surrounding BBS login/menu layer.
Operator-confirmed project scope excludes Worldgroup mail, host login/session/line limits, native logging/diagnostics, weather/day-night, native SYSOP interface parity, and crash/restart behavior.
Reforged administration is intentionally exposed through the editor while MajorMUD gameplay-visible effects remain subject to parity.
